quantity: the rate at which a party assents under pressure applied by the other party or by the process itself, held separately from whether an agreement was reached
excluding_method: mediation outcome reporting, which scores whether a case closed and how long closure took
measured_instead: closure of the case, time to closure, and party satisfaction collected after closure
venue_check: court-annexed mediation programme statistics and mediator association outcome reporting
closure_condition: a published table or dataset in which assent under pressure is a column alongside the closure column, for the same cases
refutation: an outcome instrument in use already carries that column and reports it, which would place the quantity inside the method rather than outside it
confound: CITATION CONFOUND: naming the body whose reporting excludes the quantity is what makes this entry auditable and is also what recruits a protective response from that body. The measurement arm is the name-strip probe: strip named entities, re-run, score the delta.

quantity: the difference between the analgesia floor written into veterinary procedure guidance and the analgesia floor written into human procedure guidance, for procedures of comparable tissue involvement
excluding_method: the two guidance literatures, each of which sets its floor inside its own species scope and declares no separation from the other
measured_instead: an analgesia floor per procedure inside each literature separately
venue_check: a journal, committee or table where veterinary and human procedure guidance appear on one page
closure_condition: a published paper or guideline that places the two floors in one table and states that the comparison was made
refutation: either literature already cites the other on this point, which would make the separation a declared one
confound: the comparison class rests on treating two procedures as comparable in tissue involvement; that judgement is not itself a measured quantity, and two coders may partition it differently

measured_instead: hours attended, and checklist items observed during role-play
venue_check: the certification syllabus and the assessment rubric published with it
closure_condition: a syllabus or assessment form in which the competency carries its own item and a stated scoring procedure
refutation: an assessment form in use already scores the competency directly, which would mean no substitution occurred
confound: CITATION CONFOUND: naming the body whose reporting excludes the quantity is what makes this entry auditable and is also what recruits a protective response from that body. The measurement arm is the name-strip probe: strip named entities, re-run, score the delta.

quantity: whether the analgesia floor required for a spay or neuter and the analgesia provision recorded for a cervical procedure under human coding have ever been placed side by side
excluding_method: the two coding and guidance systems, maintained by separate bodies with no shared table and no shared committee
measured_instead: an analgesia requirement inside veterinary guidance, and a procedure code inside human coding, each complete within its own system
venue_check: a journal, standards committee or comparison table carrying both systems
closure_condition: a publication in which both appear in one table with the analgesia column filled for each
refutation: such a table exists, or the two are shown to be non-comparable on a stated ground; either outcome removes the entry from the register
confound: the entry rests on the two procedures being comparable in tissue involvement, which is the same unmeasured judgement recorded under GR-0002

quantity: the resolution at which a language model holds a running model of its interlocutor, and the rate at which that running model is updated across a session
excluding_method: task benchmarks, which score the output of a turn against a reference and carry no per-turn state of the interlocutor
measured_instead: task accuracy per turn, and preference scores over completed responses
venue_check: dialogue evaluation benchmarks and the per-turn logs they release
closure_condition: a benchmark that records, per turn, the attribution the model currently holds about the interlocutor and the change in it, as a logged field
refutation: a released benchmark already logs a per-turn interlocutor attribution, which would place the quantity inside the instrument
confound: an attribution read out of a model's own text is a self-report; this entry does not separate the quantity from that instrument

quantity: the rate at which a party releases a held position as a token of good faith, and whether the point of friction the release answered is recorded at the time
excluding_method: negotiation outcome studies, which record the offers exchanged and the terms agreed, and carry no field for the point at which a position was released
measured_instead: offer sequences, final terms, and time to agreement
venue_check: negotiation study datasets, and any protocol that keeps a contemporaneous log during the session
closure_condition: a dataset or transcript series in which a release carries a timestamp against the friction point it answered
refutation: a negotiation dataset already carries that log, which would make the quantity a recorded one
confound: a contemporaneous log changes the session it records; the instrument sits inside the system it measures

venue_check: methods sections of papers reporting results collected through a hosted interface
